extensionDescription: Connects this browser to the omw daemon on this computer. Agents can then open tabs, read pages and act on them.
popupHint_unpaired: Pair this browser with the omw daemon.
popupHint_offline: The daemon is not running. Run omw start.
popupHint_rejected: The daemon refused this browser. Pair the browser again.
example_summarize_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read my active tab and summarize it in five bullet points.
example_form_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to fill in the form on my active tab with the details below. Stop before you submit it.
example_research_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to open the three most relevant sources on this topic in background tabs. Compare what they say, then close the session.
example_extract_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to copy the main table on my active tab as CSV.
example_screenshot_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to take a full-page screenshot of my active tab and tell me where you saved it.
example_pdf_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to save my active tab as an A4 PDF and tell me where you saved it.
example_links_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to list the links on my active tab in Markdown, one line for each link with its text.
example_selection_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the text that I selected on my active tab and explain it in plain words.
example_review_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the pull request on my active tab. List what it changes, the open review comments and the risks that you see.
example_thread_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the discussion on my active tab. Summarize each position and the conclusion, if there is one.
example_repo_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the repository page on my active tab. Explain what the project does and how to start using it.
example_paper_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the paper on my active tab. Summarize its problem, method, results and limits.
example_product_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to find the product on my active tab in two other shops. Compare price, shipping and seller in a table.
example_recipe_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the recipe on my active tab and write a shopping list of its ingredients.
example_job_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the job posting on my active tab and list its requirements as a checklist.
example_inbox_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the emails that are visible on my active tab and list the ones that need a reply. Do not send or delete anything.
example_video_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the title, description and top comments of the video on my active tab and summarize them.
example_debug_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to reload my active tab while you record its network requests and console messages. Tell me why the page fails.
example_translate_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read my active tab and translate its main text into English.
example_docs_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to read the documentation on my active tab and write a short usage guide with one code example.
example_code_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to collect the code blocks on my active tab and explain what each one does.
example_images_prompt: Use Skills: oh-my-webbridge to download the large images on my active tab to my download folder.
stepDaemonBody: Install omw on this computer. Then start the daemon:
stepDaemonService: To start the daemon when you log in, run omw service install.
stepPairBody: Run this command in a terminal. Then type the six-digit code that it shows.
pairInvalid: The code is incorrect or expired. Run omw pair again.
pairOffline: The daemon does not respond. Start the daemon, then try again.
pairRejected: The daemon refused the connection. Make sure that no other profile of this browser is connected.
stepScriptsBody: Firefox runs the evaluate action only after you allow user scripts.
stepTryBody: Install the agent skill. The skill tells your agent how to use omw:
stepTryPrompt: Then give your agent a task, for example:
pauseDescription: Agents cannot use this browser while it is paused.
activityDescription: Shows an edge glow, a focus frame, the agent's pointer and a changed favicon on pages that an agent controls.
scriptsDescription: The evaluate action needs user scripts.
forgetDescription: Removes the token. To connect again, pair this browser again.
